description: A coalition of civic tech groups, academic labs, and independent security researchers from EU member states, India, Japan, and South Korea forms an open-source AI intelligence alliance to monitor and reverse-engineer leaked models, sharing threat assessments and defensive tools outside government channels. Fueled by the global spread of the planning-capable openweight model, this network becomes a de facto early-warning system for misuse risks, operating in legal gray zones but gaining tacit tolerance due to its effectiveness.
